question: Among the dated events recorded before the 1960s, to which place was the district's administrative centre moved last?
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án là mốc muộn nhất trong chuỗi các lần dời trung tâm hành chính, cần mốc muộn thứ hai để xác nhận.
criterion: A move of the district's administrative centre to a new place, as recorded in the timeline.

gold_events.text: Administrative centre moved to Kirishi (formerly Soltsy).
Administrative centre moved to urban-type settlement of Budogoshch.

question: Among the dated events recorded before the 1960s, to which place did the administrative centre move next after the move back to Novaya Ladoga that rolled back the Volkhov changes?
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án là mốc kế tiếp sau mốc dời trung tâm về Novaya Ladoga, cần mốc neo và mốc đáp án.
criterion: A move of the district's administrative centre to a new place, as recorded in the timeline.

gold_events.text: Changes rolled back; centre moved again to Novaya Ladoga.
Administrative centre moved to Kirishi (formerly Soltsy).

question: Among the dated events in the timeline, summarize the moves of the district into or out of a higher-level territorial unit (governorate, viceroyalty, okrug or oblast) from the start of the 18th century up to before the 1940s.
why_needs_multiple: Tóm tắt các lần đổi đơn vị cấp trên trong một giai đoạn, cần ít nhất ba mốc.
criterion: A move of the district into or out of a higher-level territorial unit (governorate, viceroyalty, okrug or oblast). Renamings of those units are not included.

gold_events.text: Area included into Ingermanland Governorate as Ladozhsky Uyezd, centre in Staraya Ladoga.

question: By calendar year, how many years separate the district's merger into Volkhovsky District from the harmonization of the oblast's administrative division with the municipal division?
why_needs_multiple: Câu hỏi khoảng cách cần đúng hai mốc được nêu tên bằng lời.
